stonehenge.linePrev: Because they all looked as unhappy as a clown
stonehenge.line: Look long at that Stonehenge, look quick, is it something you missed?
stonehenge.lineNext: Look into that smoldering building’s bombed-out fog until it finally lifts
stanza: Look long at that Stonehenge, look quick, is it something you missed?
Look into that smoldering building’s bombed-out fog until it finally lifts
Look up at that big wave, look down at your other brother's grave
Look hard for a harder something to sacrifice, that’s what it takes
